labels.look: Edge-to-edge mosaic of code snippets (Racket, HTML, Python, LaTeX, C++) in different editor themes, plus display words and a scoreboard table
labels.learn: For a coding font, show the face across many languages and syntax themes so every visitor spots their own stack

labels.look: One archival drawing of Hoffmann's Sanatorium Purkersdorf (1903) with its geometric lettering, no caption in the block
labels.learn: Show the building lettering the revival comes from; the source image proves the lineage better than prose

labels.variantDefinition: Options (alternates, line height, spacing, ligatures) choose which pre-built font file is downloaded
labels.look: White, monospace README-style grid of labelled paragraphs (Concept, Features, Support, Readme) above 'v0.61' option rows and blue buttons
labels.ux: Pick alternates, line height, tracking and ligatures on/off, then Download; GitHub and readme links
labels.learn: Let people choose spacing and alternates before download, so they get a ready build instead of tweaking editor settings

labels.look: Pale blue, prose on Weight and Grade axes, two sliders, twin cards on a light and a dark surface (GRAD 0 vs -50)
labels.ux: Weight and Grade sliders update the sample cards live
labels.learn: Show grade on a light and an inverse surface side by side: it explains why the axis exists, not only what it does

labels.variantDefinition: The design rationale (readability, legibility) backed by a small test the visitor runs on themselves, next to research prose
labels.look: White, sticky reading-passage card with WPM slider and red START button beside prose and a step-by-step WCPM calculation
labels.ux: Pace slider, passage picker and Start run a reading-speed test with live counters (time, words, errors, WCPM)
labels.learn: Turn the font's claim into an experiment: a reading test lets the visitor measure 'more readable' instead of trusting it

labels.variantDefinition: Two or more versions of the same glyphs (default vs alternate, optical sizes, weights) superimposed in translucent colours so the differences stand out
labels.look: Yellow field, giant 'GRaj' in navy, magenta and cyan layers overprinted slightly out of register
labels.ux: Animated: alternate layers move along the optical-size axis (opsz 21-72) over the default glyphs
labels.learn: Overprint default and alternate glyphs in transparent colours: the difference itself becomes the graphic

labels.variantDefinition: A pinned, scroll-driven sequence that tells a concept metaphor (signal, journey) through animated type and diagrams before revealing the family
labels.look: Olive panels, glitched radio message 'Hel5o. Is anybody there?', frequency dial bar (MONO 87.8, SEMI 91.2, POLY 95.6), diagrams, then 'Light' in three subfamilies
labels.ux: Pinned scroll sequence; persistent dial bar with Type tester, Try and Buy buttons
labels.learn: A metaphor UI (tuning a radio between subfamilies) carried through the scroll makes a three-family system memorable

labels.variantDefinition: The character set typeset as centred running lines, one line per category (lowercase, caps, swashes, figures, symbols), not boxed cells
labels.look: Mint-tinted spice-market photo behind white centred glyph lines incl. swash caps and ligatures; yellow 'Ingredients' sticky bar; style list below
labels.ux: static; sticky section bar with cart icon
labels.learn: Call the glyph set 'Ingredients' and lay it over a market photo: the charset becomes part of the brand story

labels.look: Dark navy, monospace feature list: 'Variable', cv01/cv04/zero glyph trios, ligature grid, DEBUG/TODO tag ligatures, each with a toggle
labels.ux: Per-feature toggles (cv01, cv04, zero, calt, ligatures on/off) switch the samples live
labels.learn: Name each option with its exact feature tag plus a one-line reason, so developers know what to put in their editor config
